releases.notes:
## New Features

- Added a throwable paint bucket: hold right-click to charge, release to throw, and every concrete
  block within the landing radius gets painted. The radius grows with charge time, up to 13 blocks
  at 10 seconds. Throwing costs 1.5 durability per painted block (capped at 500), and the bucket
  comes back as an empty bucket once it runs out.
- Added 10 custom advancements on a new `color_action` trigger, covering painting, throwing and
  cleaning, including three challenges (paint at least 50 blocks with a single throw, paint
  red/green/blue, and clean a black block back to white).
- Added a cast sound when the bucket is thrown, and a splash of color particles where it lands.
- Added a colored particle trail behind the bucket while it is in flight.
- Updated the paint bucket texture and its tintable overlay.

## Fixes

- Fixed colored items rendering untinted on 26.1.2. The item model's `minecraft:dye` tint samples
  the vanilla `minecraft:dyed_color` component, but mined drops, `/givec` and the color picker's
  concrete preview only wrote the mod's own color component, so the tint had nothing to read. All
  three now share one helper that writes both.
- Fixed the color picker's concrete preview block always rendering white on 26.1.2, for the same
  missing-component reason.
- Fixed `/givec` storing a bare 24-bit color instead of opaque ARGB. A `/givec` block and a block
  painted with the picker therefore compared unequal at the same color, which made the
  durability-aware recipe treat them as different and spend durability.
- Fixed the ModernUI tooltip color leaking into later, unrelated tooltips. ModernUI keeps its fill
  color in a static array, so the override is now snapshotted and restored.
- Fixed a ModernUI method rename being able to throw an injection error into the render path. The
  injection is optional now, so a missing target degrades to "no tint" instead of crashing, and
  member resolution is latched so it logs once per launch, not once per frame.
- Fixed painting a vanilla concrete block not showing on the client until the block re-synced.
- Fixed the clean agent completing cleaning advancements on blocks that were already white, and
  changed its check to "became white" so the two cleaning challenges no longer finish on the first
  use.
- Fixed the advancement screen background not rendering on 1.21.1.
- Fixed a `No data fixer registered for colorblockmc:paint_bucket_projectile` error printed on
  every world load on 1.21.1.
- Fixed an unsupported mixin compatibility level warning printed on every launch on 26.1.2.

## Colorful Blocks 2.8.1

Fixes

- Fixed the ModernUI crash when opening the color picker by replacing the vanilla edit box with a custom hex input widget
- Fixed the hex input showing a stale value after the color was changed with the square picker or the sliders (the value is now only skipped when the change comes from the hex field itself)
- Fixed the hex input being hard to see on 1.21.1 and unified the color picker layout between the 1.21.1 and 26.1.2 builds (blurred background, panel layering and widget look are now identical)
- Fixed the Jade tooltip not showing the hex value properly (separate provider IDs so priorities no longer collide, uppercase `#RRGGBB`, colored swatch restored)
- Fixed item tooltips: the hex value is now always complete and uppercase (`#RRGGBB`) and tinted with the item color (e.g. `#FF0000` shown in red)
- Fixed the stained concrete preview initializing too early in the screen (now lazily created when the player is available)

releases.notes:
## v2.7.0

### Added
- **`/givec` command** — Give yourself a stained concrete block of any hex color directly, no Paint Bucket needed.
  - Usage: `/givec <color> [count] [glowing]`
  - `<color>` accepts a hex code with or without `#` (e.g. `#FF6B35` or `FF6B35`)
  - `[count]` — how many to give (auto-split into stacks)
  - `[glowing]` — set to `true` for Glowing Stained Concrete
  - Requires operator (permission level 2)
  - Example: `/givec #FF6B35 16 true`

### Files
| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `Colorful Blocks-26.1.2-2.7.0-fabric.jar` | Main mod jar (Minecraft 26.1.2) |
| `Colorful Blocks-1.21.1-2.7.0-fabric.jar` | Main mod jar (Minecraft 1.21.1) |
